name: Agility Robotics Digit 5
summary: A bipedal tote-handling humanoid with swappable grippers that lifts up to 22.7 kg; Agility plans EU and UK early access from the first half of 2027.

germany.statusNote: Not orderable yet: for the first time Agility plans to offer Digit outside North America, starting with the EU and UK. Early access to Digit 5 is expected in the first half of 2027 and general availability by the end of 2027, with a CE mark expected. Today only the Agility sales contact form; no EU price or partner.
germany.leadTime: EU early access expected H1 2027; general availability expected end of 2027

specs.label: Payload
specs.conditions: repeated lifts, stated as 50 lb; both arms together

specs.label: Work per day
specs.conditions: more than 20 h in a 24 h day

specs.label: End effectors
specs.value: swappable grippers on ISO-standard mounting flanges

specs.label: Safety compute
specs.value: independent safety controller; NVIDIA IGX Thor and Halos

notes: Payload 22.7 kg is for the robot, lifting with both arms.
Designed to work near people without fences (human detection, safety controller); Agility contributes to ISO 25785-1.
Fleet software Agility Arc connects to WMS, WES, MES and AMRs.
